agentPrincipals.title: Agent Principals
agentPrincipals.subtitle: Identities that AI agents run as. Each is scoped to the capabilities you choose, has its own token, and appears under its own name in the audit trail.

form.heading: New agent principal
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional — shown to whoever reviews its held actions
form.capabilitiesHint: Only what the workspace itself grants can be chosen. Reads are never held; writes still go through workspace policies.
form.capabilitiesNone: This workspace holds no MCP capabilities yet. Enable an app first.

token.rotateTitle: Issue a new token (revokes the current one)
token.warning: Copy it now. It is shown once, and issuing another revokes this one.
token.bridgeHint: Use it as AEXY_API_TOKEN with the aexy-mcp bridge, or as a Bearer token against the MCP endpoint. The principal is already bound to this workspace.

actions.removeTitle: Remove principal (revokes its tokens; kept in the audit trail)

empty.title: No agent principals yet
empty.description: Create one to let a scheduled or event-driven agent act in this workspace as itself, rather than as a person.

agentPrincipals.footer: Deactivating revokes every token at once. Removing also detaches the principal from the workspace; its rows stay so the ledger can still name it.
agentPrincipals.adminOnly: Only workspace admins can manage agent principals.
